name: 3C-MAL
summary: 3C-MAL, also known as 4-methylallyloxy-3,5-dimethoxyamphetamine or as α-methylmethallylescaline (3C-methallylescaline), is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and 3C families related to the psychedelic drug 3,4,5-trimethoxyamphetamine (TMA). It is the amphetamine (3C) analogue of the psychedelic methallylescaline (MAL).

pharmacology.text: The compound does not appear to have been tested in humans, and its dose, duration, and effects are unknown.
